messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed an infra IAM path-filter change that's blocking the ephemeral-credentials role used by GPU pool nodes in us-west-3. nodes failing to attach.
ops-bot: Alert: iam/path-filter-change detected for prod-usw3 at 2026-03-23T12:01:05Z. policy_id=pf-0192
kevin: Copy. Any evidence it's path-filter and not an sts grant expiry?
maria: Checked CloudTrail + authz logs. Deny entries show Condition StringLike on iam:ResourcePath matched and rejected the role ARN. example deny: 
```json
{
  "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ephemeral/llm-node-usw3",
  "Condition": {"StringLike": {"iam:ResourcePath": "/ephemeral/llm-*"}}
}
```
olivia: That pattern looks like it was tightened in yesterday's audit-hardening rollout. Did security change the prefix? :eyes:
natalie: Yup, security rolled PR #987 — intended to restrict to `/ephemeral/llm-*` but one of the staging-to-prod transforms collapsed a wildcard and newer node role uses `/ephemeral/llm-node-usw3` which doesn't match. my bad.
sam: Impact summary: ~30 pending GPU node joins in usw3 stuck, warm pool draining, batch latency spiking ~2.3x, some customer inference tail latencies rising.
maria: Can we emergency allowlist the specific role ARN while we patch the pattern? That should let nodes come up without rolling back the whole change.
kevin: I can push a patch to add explicit Resource ARNs to the path-filter allowlist and deploy a targeted change. prepping terraform tweak now.
security-bot: @kevin started deploy pipeline: infra-ci/job/6423. running tests.
kevin: CI green, applying policy change to prod-usw3.
ops-bot: Policy apply completed for policy pf-0192 in prod-usw3 by kevin at 2026-03-23T12:03:22Z.
sam: nodes starting to join — warm pool +3 within 2 mins. reducing latency backlog.
maria: Good. Next steps: natalie to update PR to use more explicit pattern matching + add unit test for iam:ResourcePath shapes; olivia to confirm no other regions affected; kevin to follow up with post-deploy audit.
natalie: Will open follow-up PR to change pattern to `/ephemeral/llm-node-*` and include list of allowed role ARNs. adding integration test against staging authz logs.
olivia: I'll run a quick sweep across regions for similar role name discrepancies.
maria: Thanks all. Filing a short postmortem doc in confluence and tagging infra/security. If anyone sees new denies, ping here. :thumbsup:
